$comment: Provenance record for docs/contract.json. VCF Automation has no machine-readable specification published in the vmware/vcf-api-specs repository, so the contract was hand-derived from the Broadcom xAPIs reference documentation listed below. Every page here was fetched and read; pages that failed to render are recorded in 'unavailable_pages' so the gaps in the contract are auditable.

specification_repository_checked.result: No VCF Automation specification is published there. The repository carries specifications for other VCF components only, so no machine-readable source was available for this contract.

sources.title: APIs - Broadcom Developer Portal
sources.documents: Index of published xAPI references. Used to establish which VCF Automation services have reference documentation (Provider Infrastructure, Org Management, VM Apps Org services, All Apps Org services).

sources.title: VM Apps Org - Catalog :: Authentication
sources.documents: Security scheme for the VCF Automation API. Read verbatim: scheme name 'bearerAuth', type 'http', scheme 'bearer', bearerFormat 'JWT'. Source for the Authorization header form used by every protected operation in the contract.

sources.title: VM Apps Org - Identity :: REST API Index
sources.documents: Full operation index for the Identity Service. Used to enumerate the token-issuing operations and to confirm that the successor endpoints named in the deprecation notices (/oidc/oauth2/token, /oauth/tenant/{tenant}/token) are referenced but have no detail page in the reference.

sources.title: VM Apps Org - Identity :: Authentication Controller
sources.documents: Operation list for the Authentication Controller, including 'Get Access Token Pkce Flow' (POST /csp/gateway/am/api/auth/token) and 'Get Access Token With Refresh Token' (POST /csp/gateway/am/api/auth/api-tokens/authorize).

sources.title: VM Apps Org - Identity :: Get Access Token Pkce Flow
sources.documents: Primary source for the token operation in this contract, and the only token operation in the reference that annotates every response field and publishes a full status-code list. Read verbatim: request body mimetype application/x-www-form-urlencoded; a REQUIRED 'authorization' header documented as 'Basic Base64_Encode(client_id:client_secret)' with the verbatim example 'authorization: Basic Y2xpZW50X2lkOmNsaWVudF9zZWNyZXQ=' (public clients use 'Basic Base64_Encode(client_id:)' with an empty secret); request field grant_type (required) plus optional code, redirect_uri, refresh_token, scope, org_id, subject_token, subject_token_type, code_verifier, client_id; response AccessToken as application/json with all fields optional: scope, access_token, refresh_token, id_token, token_type, expires_in (integer as int64); status codes 200, 400, 403 ('Client is forbidden for delegation.'), 404 ('Organization with this identifier is not found.'); marked deprecated in favour of /oidc/oauth2/token.

sources.title: VM Apps Org - Identity :: Get Access Token With Refresh Token
sources.documents: Alternative token operation, read for corroboration of the token response shape (access_token, refresh_token, id_token, token_type, scope, expires_in). Also marked deprecated in favour of /oidc/oauth2/token. Not used by this contract because its documented request field is api_token rather than an OAuth2 refresh grant.

sources.title: VM Apps Org - Identity :: Login Oauth
sources.documents: Read for corroboration of the AccessToken response body (scope, access_token, refresh_token, id_token, token_type, expires_in), which is identical to the one returned by POST /csp/gateway/am/api/auth/token. Documents grant_type and state as required and refresh_token as the optional field used when grant_type is refresh_token. Also marked deprecated in favour of /oidc/oauth2/token.

sources.title: VM Apps Org - Identity :: Login
sources.documents: Username/password login returning cspAuthToken. Read to confirm it is deprecated and is NOT a refresh-capable operation, which is why the contract uses the OAuth2 token endpoint instead.

sources.title: VM Apps Org - Identity :: Login Controller
sources.documents: Operation list confirming both /csp/gateway/am/api/login and /csp/gateway/am/api/login/oauth are deprecated.

sources.title: VM Apps Org - Catalog :: Catalog Items
sources.documents: Operation list for catalog items, establishing the paths GET /catalog/api/items, GET /catalog/api/items/{id}, POST /catalog/api/items/{id}/request and the upfront-price and versions operations.

sources.title: VM Apps Org - Catalog :: Fetch a list of catalog items
sources.documents: Read verbatim: the complete set of 11 query parameters (page, size, sort, search, projects, types, expandProjects, expand, $top, $skip, $orderby) and the PageCatalogItem envelope fields (content, empty, first, last, number, numberOfElements, pageable, size, sort, totalElements, totalPages). Confirmed there is no expandVersions parameter and no singular projectId parameter on this operation.

sources.title: VM Apps Org - Catalog :: Create a deployment
sources.documents: Read verbatim: request body CatalogItemRequest with fields bulkRequestCount, deploymentName, inputs, projectId, reason, version, all annotated optional; deploymentName maxLength 900; reason maxLength 10240; response is an array of CatalogItemRequestResponse containing only deploymentId and deploymentName; status codes 200, 400, 401, 403, 404. Confirmed deploymentId is not a request body field and that catalogItemId/version/requestId are not response fields.

sources.title: VM Apps Org - Deployment :: Deployments
sources.documents: Operation list for deployments, establishing the by-id, resources and per-project count operations.

sources.title: VM Apps Org - Deployment :: Requests
sources.documents: Operation list for deployment requests, establishing GET /deployment/api/deployments/{deploymentId}/requests and GET /deployment/api/requests/{requestId} along with the request events and action operations.

sources.title: VM Apps Org - Deployment :: Get Deployments
sources.documents: Read to confirm the wire base path is /deployment/api/deployments rather than a bare /deployments, and to establish the PageDeployment envelope shape shared by the paged request collection. Confirmed no apiVersion query parameter exists on this service.

sources.title: VM Apps Org - Deployment :: Get Deployment By Id
sources.documents: Read for the single-deployment shape and to confirm its query parameters are limited to expand, the deprecated expandResources/expandLastRequest/expandProject booleans, and deleted. Documented status codes 200, 401, 404.

sources.title: VM Apps Org - Deployment :: Get Deployment Requests
sources.documents: Read verbatim: returns a PageRequest envelope with the same 11 paging fields; query parameters deleted, inprogressRequests, search, page, size, sort, $top, $skip, $orderby.

sources.title: VM Apps Org - Deployment :: Get Request
sources.documents: Read verbatim: the full Request response body (actionId, approvedAt, blueprintId, cancelable, catalogItemId, completedAt, completedTasks, createdAt, deploymentId, details, dismissed, estimatedCompletionTime, id, initializedAt, inputs, name, outputs, requestedBy, resourceIds, resources, status, totalTasks, updatedAt) and the 12-value status enum. Confirmed progress is reported as completedTasks/totalTasks and that no query parameters are documented.

sources.title: VM Apps Org - Deployment :: Get Deployments (9.1 pinned)
sources.documents: Fetched with the explicit 9.1 path segment instead of 'latest' to confirm that 'latest' resolves to 9.1 and that the operation content is identical. This is the basis for pinning the contract to 9.1.

unavailable_pages.result: Object Not Found. The reference names /oidc/oauth2/token as the replacement for the deprecated token operations but publishes no detail page for it, so its wire shape could not be derived. The contract therefore models the documented POST /csp/gateway/am/api/auth/token operation and records the deprecation.
Object Not Found. /oauth/tenant/{tenant}/token is named as a successor in the deprecation notice on POST /csp/gateway/am/api/login but has no detail page in the reference.
